scope: All modeled scalar eliminable cast pairs in the LLVM table are covered. IntegerType rows use arbitrary valid widths, including trunc/trunc, zext/zext, sext/sext, zext/sext, every extension followed by trunc width ordering, and the integer bitcast rows. The seven additional same-width IntegerType/ByteType triples are covered at arbitrary nonzero widths; B->I->B uses refinement because whole-value integer poison may discard per-bit information. The memory-independent pointer subset covers same-address-space P->P->P, P->P->B, P->B->B, and P->B->I (the last emits ptrtoint), with byte/integer pointer endpoints fixed by the modeled 64-bit pointer width. All source poison flags are modeled and replacement flags are cleared exactly where LLVM creates an unflagged cast.
